visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two hosts in white traditional Chinese jackets stand in a modern lounge area. The environment is brightly lit with warm indoor lights. The main host on the left wears glasses, holding a yellow microphone, and speaks with a friendly smile. The background includes a wooden wall, a refrigerator with posters, and minimal office furniture. (2) A young woman (Hazel) wearing a white blouse and a dark blue cardigan joins the hosts. She gestures with her hands as she laughs and talks. The camera remains eye-level, capturing the interaction. The background remains the same office setting with bright, flat lighting. (3) The camera cuts to a close-up of a red Coca-Cola tote bag being held by the woman. She reaches inside and pulls out plastic bottles of Coca-Cola with customized white text on the red labels. The hosts' hands are visible reaching for the bottles to inspect them. (4) A different male guest, wearing a black jacket and a navy blue baseball cap, is interviewed in a slightly different office corridor. He holds a customized Coca-Cola bottle. The lighting is bright and even. The camera uses a medium-shot framing distance. (5) Digital graphic overlays replace the real-world scene. A prize list for a promotional campaign is displayed, followed by 3D rendered scenes of a brand pop-up booth at an outdoor park. The colors are vivid and brand-aligned red and white.
